data.name: Help
data.value: Winora 0.1.0 — simulation foundation --help | --version simulate preview|apply|recover|history [--json] [--database PATH] discover startup|tasks|services|apps|all [--json] [--filter TEXT] [--limit N] (read-only) diagnostics export [--to FOLDER] [--json] | log-path (local redacted support archive; nothing is uploaded) settings list|show|preview|apply|revert|complete|history|recover ... (real user settings; changes are reviewed first, see settings usage) machine selftest [--json] (exercises the administrator channel with a harmless no-op; needs the signed per-machine install; changes nothing) machine plan|apply|revert|recover|history (administrator-level changes from the trusted list; apply and revert need an interactive console; none are available in this release) Simulation commands change only application-owned data. settings commands change your real Windows user settings, only after a review you confirm (or --yes). Discovery only reads.

data.name: Failed
data.value: Operation failed; no success is claimed. Inspect the journal before retrying.

data.name: RecordsFolderParentUnsafe
data.value: Winora stopped. Other accounts can change a folder above %ProgramData%\Winora, so Winora cannot keep its records there safely. Ask an administrator to fix the rights of that folder. Then start Winora again.

data.name: RecordsFolderUnsafe
data.value: Winora stopped. The folder %ProgramData%\Winora is not safe, and Winora could not replace it. Ask an administrator to move or delete that folder. Then start Winora again.

data.name: Code_operation_recovery_required
data.value: An earlier operation needs recovery first. Restart Winora or run recover so it can be reconciled.

data.name: Code_operation_superseded
data.value: A newer operation has changed this value, so this older operation can no longer be reverted. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Code_operation_revision_unknown
data.value: The journal has no record of the exact state this operation produced, so it cannot be reverted safely.

data.name: Code_operation_resource_changed
data.value: The value changed while the action was starting. Nothing was changed; review the current value and try again.

data.name: Code_operation_external_conflict
data.value: The value was changed by something else, so Winora did not overwrite it. Review the current value.

data.name: Code_operation_verification_failed
data.value: The value was written but could not be verified. Review is required.

data.name: Code_operation_reconciled_partial
data.value: After an interruption the value matched neither the original nor the requested value. Review is required.

data.name: Code_operation_rollback_uncertain
data.value: The revert could not be confirmed. Review is required.

data.name: Code_operation_rollback_failed
data.value: The revert did not restore the previous value. Review is required.

data.name: Code_operation_cancelled
data.value: The action was cancelled before it changed anything.

data.name: Code_plan_stale
data.value: The value changed after you reviewed it. Nothing was applied; review the change again.

data.name: Code_plan_duplicate_feature
data.value: The plan lists the same feature more than once.

data.name: Code_plan_missing_dependency
data.value: The plan depends on a feature that is not part of it.

data.name: Code_plan_resource_conflict
data.value: Two features in the plan change the same resource.

data.name: Code_plan_dependency_cycle
data.value: The plan has features that depend on each other in a cycle.

data.name: Code_journal_revision_conflict
data.value: The record was changed by another action. Refresh and try again.

data.name: Code_journal_operation_missing
data.value: The operation record could not be found.

data.name: Code_journal_invalid_transition
data.value: That change of state is not allowed for this operation.

data.name: Code_journal_invalid
data.value: Winora's local journal could not be read safely, so it stopped to protect your data. No Windows setting was changed.

data.name: Code_journal_schema_unsupported

data.name: Code_journal_schema_corrupt

data.name: Code_journal_migration_conflict
data.value: The local journal could not be upgraded safely and was not changed.

data.name: Code_journal_untrusted_definition

data.name: Code_store_unavailable
data.value: Winora's local storage could not be reached. Nothing was changed; check disk access and try again.

data.name: Code_store_failure

data.name: Code_protocol_feature

data.value: Usage: machine selftest [--json]. Exercises the administrator channel with a harmless no-op. It needs the signed per-machine installation of Winora and an interactive window.

data.name: MachineBanner
data.value: Administrator channel self-test. This starts the Winora administrator helper (Windows asks for your consent), sends it one harmless no-op that reads and changes nothing, and checks the answer. It works only from the signed per-machine installation of Winora and only in an interactive window. No setting on this computer is changed and nothing is recorded in your history.

data.name: Setting_privacy_welcome_experience_Description

data.name: Setting_privacy_suggested_toasts_Description

data.name: Setting_privacy_feedback_frequency_Description
data.value: Choose how often Windows asks you for feedback.

data.name: Setting_privacy_input_personalization_Description

data.name: Setting_privacy_third_party_suggestions_Description

data.name: Setting_privacy_cross_device_resume_Description

data.name: Setting_search_highlights_Description
data.value: Show daily pictures and events in the search box.

data.value: Let Windows give games more of the PC's power. Leaving it on is recommended.

data.name: Setting_apps_game_capture_Description
data.value: Let Windows record gameplay in the background and save clips with the Game Bar. Turning it off stops clip recording.

data.name: Setting_apps_new_outlook_migration_Description
data.value: Stop classic Outlook from moving you to the new Outlook by itself. It only matters when classic Outlook is installed.

data.name: Setting_performance_storage_sense_Description
data.value: Let Windows free disk space on its own by deleting temporary files and emptying the recycle bin on a schedule.

data.name: Setting_performance_app_shutdown_timeouts_Description
data.value: Choose how long Windows waits for apps to close at sign-out and shutdown. A short wait can cut off an app that is still saving. Takes effect after you sign out and in.

data.name: Setting_performance_auto_end_tasks_Title
data.value: End apps at shutdown without asking

data.name: Setting_performance_auto_end_tasks_Description
data.value: Close apps at sign-out and shutdown without asking you first. Unsaved work in those apps is lost. Takes effect after you sign out and in.
